name: the-wait-flushes-what-it-says
breaks: the wait goes back to bare print, which Python block-buffers the moment stdout is not a terminal. Every elapsed line, every retry and every notice that the head commit moved then arrives at the end or not at all, and a wait redirected to a file, which is how a long one is actually run, is indistinguishable from one that has stalled (L106)
